title: After downloading a plugin — choose projects

steps.headline: After Install succeeds, should this detail panel turn into project setup?
steps.changed: The plugin is installed once on this device but starts inactive in every project. The same Marketplace panel switches to a focused project list: expand a project, turn on Inbox, then choose its skill. Repeat for as many projects as you want.
steps.notice: Closing or Done keeps the download installed, even if no project was enabled; it can be configured later in Projects. Changes apply to new conversations.
steps.risk: The three projects and switches are workbench samples, not real saved choices. The user may want a more explicit completed-download cue.

steps.headline: Do the project rows, per-skill switch, and Done action fit on your phone?
steps.changed: The same panel uses the existing Marketplace phone inset and scrolls if the project list grows. The first project opens so the plugin and its skill are visible without a second tap.
steps.notice: Each project can be expanded separately; the plugin master pauses automatic use while preserving item choices.
steps.risk: This is a workbench-only preview. No project settings are saved yet.
